description:
Mat’s speccing his own Pagani Utopia… But there’s a catch! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-07-08

Mat’s flown over to Italy to visit the Pagani factory, and he’s going to find out what the process is like when speccing your very own hypercar! 

Of course, given the Utopia starts from €3,100,000, he won’t be buying one! But he’s still going to find out what options are available when speccing such a car. 

For starters, one area you can’t alter is the engine. Every Utopia is powered by a 6-litre twin-turbo V12 AMG engine, which produces 852 to 864hp, with the ability to hit 62mph in just 3.1 seconds. The power is sent to the rear wheels, and the dry weight is only 1,280kg. 

However, when it comes to any other element of the car, the customisation options are almost endless!
